about: What the map does not say about a named bridge, keyed by its Wikidata id (OSM wikidata of the bridge outline or way). Every key is optional and overrides the type rules of kinds/bridge (support, body, structure, parapets, piers, pylons, arches). Carried over from the old generator's per-bridge PROFILES in coarse/bridge_details.py (photo-supported there) and extended from the reference photos named in `evidence`. Dimensions are estimates from photos unless `evidence` says measured.

Q11853512.name: Auransilta
Q11853512.evidence: old generator PROFILES (steel body on stone supports, heritage railing, four 4.8 m end pylons); photos review_08 (west abutment from the bank: granite ashlar, arched gated passage in the downstream face, pylon at the river corner, stone balustrade), sv_10 (from the deck: white lattice railing on the span, granite obelisk with bronze lantern, balustrade on the abutment)
